notes: Payment of the customers' dues (incentives / rents registered with AR_CUSTOMER_DUES): header per transaction type with the paid lines; buttons execute (fill), post (GL voucher + customers' credit transactions) and cancel posting; the generated single form was corrected; rules in APP_RULES3_AR.

rules.where: MAST_ID in (select ID from AR_TRNSTYPE where EFFECT = 1 and TRNS_TYPE = 6) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or MAST_ID in (select TRNS_ID from AR_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD where FLAG = 1 and PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

AR_CUSTOMER_DUES_PAY.MAST_ID.value: select min(id) from ar_trnstype where effect = 1 and trns_type = 6

AR_CUSTOMER_DUES_PAY.MAST_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = 1 and trns_type = 6 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from ar_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

AR_CUSTOMER_DUES_PAY.SALESMAN_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from salesman where (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (code >= (select min(from_salesman) from ar_customer_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and code <= (select max(to_salesman) from ar_customer_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

info.name: DUE
info.sql: select to_char(sum(app_rules3_ar.pay_due(mast_id, mast_serial, customer_code, salesman_code, 'DUE')), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from ar_customer_dues_pay_det where mast_id = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_ID) and mast_serial = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_SERIAL)

info.name: PAID
info.sql: select to_char(sum(app_rules3_ar.pay_due(mast_id, mast_serial, customer_code, salesman_code, 'PAID')), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from ar_customer_dues_pay_det where mast_id = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_ID) and mast_serial = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_SERIAL)

info.name: PAY
info.sql: select to_char(sum(pay_amount), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from ar_customer_dues_pay_det where mast_id = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_ID) and mast_serial = to_number(:PAGE_MAST_SERIAL)

info.name: POST
info.sql: select case when nvl(post_flag, 0) = 1 then app_rules3_ar.msg('القيد مرحل ', 'Posted voucher ') || entry_year || '/' || entry_type || '/' || entry_no else app_rules3_ar.msg('القيد غر مرحل', 'Not posted') end from ar_customer_dues_pay where rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID)

actions.name: FILL
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد إنزال مستحقات العملاء غير المصروفة؟

actions.name: POST
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد ترحيل الصرف إلى الحسابات؟
actions.confirm_e: Post the payment to the accounts?

actions.name: UNPOST
actions.confirm_e: Cancel the posting of the payment?
